journal: Wiley journals with Free Format submission (shared rules)
snapshot_note: Rules that three Wiley Author Guidelines pages state word for word in their Free Format submission section (Proteins; Journal of Cellular and Molecular Medicine; Journal of Cellular Biochemistry). Abstract and keyword limits, word limits, reference style after acceptance and article types differ by journal (for example abstract at most 250, 200 or 300 words): SubmitReady reads those from the journal's own page on every run. Revised files usually must follow the full journal format.
